<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="card" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D0CECD"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#939393"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="21" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="329" y1="17" x2="329" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="15" x2="334" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="12" x2="339" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="353" y1="20" x2="357" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="12" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="14" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="386" y="15" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- underlying verification profile -->
  <g opacity=".96">
    <text x="24" y="67" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile check</text>
    <circle cx="348" cy="58" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".26"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="58" x2="356" y2="58" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="50" x2="348" y2="66" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="24" y="92" width="342" height="470" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="24" y="92" width="342" height="332" rx="18" fill="url(#card)"/>
      <circle cx="294" cy="139" r="55" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity=".7"/>
      <circle cx="315" cy="125" r="8" fill="#EFC54D"/>
      <polygon points="55,385 142,275 190,334 236,282 342,424 55,424" fill="#7D8490" opacity=".7"/>
      <polygon points="125,424 213,337 254,374 292,337 366,424" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".7"/>
      <text x="45" y="466" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Maya, 27</text>
      <circle cx="143" cy="458" r="5" fill="#4396F7"/>
      <text x="45" y="493" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your profile photo</text>
      <rect x="45" y="515" width="96" height="25" rx="13" fill="#96E063"/>
      <text x="93" y="532" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">PHOTO 1 OF 4</text>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="65" y="690" width="260" height="44" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="195" y="717" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- dimmed background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".48"/>

  <!-- bottom navigation behind dialog -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".92"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2">
    <polygon points="39,791 48,783 57,791 57,803 39,803"/>
    <circle cx="137" cy="790" r="7"/>
    <line x1="137" y1="797" x2="137" y2="805"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="792" r="8"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="786" x2="201" y2="798"/>
    <line x1="201" y1="786" x2="189" y2="798"/>
    <rect x="276" y="784" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/>
    <circle cx="285" cy="780" r="3"/>
    <line x1="280" y1="805" x2="290" y2="805"/>
  </g>
  <text x="48" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">DISCOVER</text>
  <text x="137" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">LIKES</text>
  <text x="195" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">MATCHES</text>
  <text x="285" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">PROFILE</text>

  <!-- centered modal shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="28" y="139" width="334" height="514" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity=".25"/>
  <rect x="28" y="133" width="334" height="514" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- verification icon -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="190" r="35" fill="#FE3675"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="181" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="207" rx="17" ry="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="213,190 219,196 229,184" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <text x="195" y="258" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">How it works</text>
  <text x="195" y="286" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Take a quick video selfie to verify</text>
  <text x="195" y="304" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">that you’re really you.</text>

  <!-- steps -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="69" cy="350" r="19" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="345" r="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <ellipse cx="69" cy="357" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="102" y="347" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Follow the pose</text>
    <text x="102" y="367" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Copy the gesture shown on screen.</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="50" y1="389" x2="340" y2="389" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <circle cx="69" cy="426" r="19" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <rect x="60" y="417" width="18" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="424" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="75" cy="420" r="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="102" y="423" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Show your face</text>
    <text x="102" y="443" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Keep your face visible and well lit.</text>
  </g>
  <line x1="50" y1="465" x2="340" y2="465" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <circle cx="69" cy="502" r="19" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <polyline points="60,502 66,508 78,495" fill="none" stroke="#96E063" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="102" y="499" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Get verified</text>
    <text x="102" y="519" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">A verification badge will appear on your profile.</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="51" y="546" width="288" height="1" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
  <text x="195" y="572" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your video is deleted after verification.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="51" y="589" width="178" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#bg)"/>
    <text x="140" y="616" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">NEXT</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="240" y="589" width="99" height="44" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="289" y="616" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">CANCEL</text>
  </g>
</svg>
